description: State and result of a private purchase test started with lancer_test (or paid per request with x402), by its id. No key needed: the id is the secret. Use it after lancer_test, every few minutes, until statut is termine or echec. For published results of tracked stores, use consulter_marchand instead. Returns: id, statut (en_attente, en_cours, termine or echec), domaine, produit, demande_le, commence_le, termine_le, dossier (private evidence report page: give this link to the user, it holds the screenshots, the proof of each fact and the log of the agent's actions), and once finished resultat: note (score out of 100), etapes (six steps, each reussi, partiel, echec or non_atteint with a motif), faits (oui, non or inconnu), lisibilite, captures and resume (one-sentence summary to quote). A failed test gives message and is not counted against the quota. Unknown id: error result.

id.description: Test id returned by lancer_test: 48 hexadecimal characters.
